name: OpenAI API
description: Serves OpenAI models through the Responses and Chat Completions APIs, with function calling, file search, realtime voice, and remote MCP tools, for developers building model-backed apps.

skills.name: Text Generation
skills.description: Generates text, code, and structured JSON from prompts with OpenAI models through the Responses API.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets models call developer-defined functions described by JSON schema to reach application data and actions.

skills.name: Remote MCP Servers
skills.description: Gives models tools from remote MCP servers, or private ones through Secure MCP Tunnel, during a response.

skills.name: File Search
skills.description: Retrieves passages from uploaded files in vector stores with semantic and keyword search inside the Responses API.

skills.name: Realtime API
skills.description: Runs speech-to-speech voice sessions where the model works on audio directly, keeps state, and calls tools.
